description: This file defines the PdfTilingPattern class, which represents a tiling pattern dictionary used in PDF processing within the PdfSharp library. It includes definitions for pattern properties and keys relevant to PDF tiling patterns.

classes.name: PdfTilingPattern
classes.description: Represents a tiling pattern dictionary in a PDF document, inheriting from PdfDictionaryWithContentStream, providing properties and keys for pattern configuration.

methods.name: PdfTilingPattern
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new tiling pattern object associated with a PDF document.
